'''Tam Blackstar''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Hunter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who led [[Dark Blade Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He amassed an impressive kill streak against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilots and was known for his insane maneuvers. His squadron participated in the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|attack on]] the [[Arda Base|Rebel base]] on [[Arda I]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] during which he pursued a fleeing [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] through the narrow canyon known as [[The Gauntlet (Arda I)|the Gauntlet]].<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tam Blackstar is one of the enemy characters in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] adventure book ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''.<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
